purpose: Claude Code-ready PRD, hackathon requirements, technical architecture, and implementation specs for a nonpartisan election transparency agent.

required_runtime_elements: Gemini or Google Cloud agent orchestration
Partner MCP-backed tool call in the visible agent workflow
hackathon_alignment.address_to_district_layer: Geocod.io district resolver with cd120 support for 2026 election workflows
hackathon_alignment.agent_ui_layer: CopilotKit for ADK/Gemini-connected copilot panel, typed generative UI, frontend tools, and human-in-the-loop interactions; OpenUI deferred to post-MVP experimentation
hackathon_alignment.state_local_election_layer: Contest-oriented ballot layer using BallotReady/CivicEngine or Ballotpedia Data API for current races, official state/local sources for verification and curated fallback, optional Perplexity + TabStack bridge for official-source discovery/extraction when provider data is stale or unavailable, Democracy Works for calendars, OpenStates/Vote Smart/Cicero for enrichment, and Google Civic as fallback-only.
hackathon_alignment.frontend_design_system: HeroUI Pro with a restrained Civic Brutal variant of the Brutalism theme for deterministic dashboard components; CopilotKit remains the agent interaction and typed generative UI layer.
hackathon_alignment.developer_ui_mcp: HeroUI Pro MCP may be used in Claude Code for development-time component, CSS, and theme documentation lookup. It is not the runtime partner MCP used for hackathon scoring.

architecture_decisions.state_local_election_layer: Contest-oriented ballot layer using BallotReady/CivicEngine or Ballotpedia Data API for current races, official state/local sources for verification/fallback, Democracy Works for election calendars and voter guidance, OpenStates/Vote Smart/Cicero for enrichment, and Google Civic as fallback-only.
architecture_decisions.local_race_discovery_bridge: Use Perplexity Search API for official-domain local election page discovery and TabStack for schema-constrained extraction from selected official URLs. Treat as fallback/verification automation only, with provenance, validation, source confidence, and human review.
architecture_decisions.bulk_import_refresh_strategy: MongoDB is the primary application read model seeded by selective FEC and Congress.gov/GPO imports; official APIs are retained for missing, stale, or user-requested refreshes and must upsert refreshed data back into MongoDB.
architecture_decisions.clerk_auth_strategy: Use Clerk as an optional public-first authentication layer for saved user features and protected admin/import/refresh operations; do not require sign-in for core civic reads or basic agent answers.
architecture_decisions.legislator_enrichment_import: Use unitedstates/congress-legislators as a MongoDB bulk-import enrichment source for Bioguide-centered member identity, official webpages, social links, district offices, committees, FEC crosswalks, and photo resolver metadata; keep Congress.gov/GovInfo/GPO authoritative for legislative facts and FEC authoritative for finance.

updated_notes: Revised state/local strategy to demote Google Civic to fallback-only and prefer BallotReady/CivicEngine or Ballotpedia for current race data.
Added optional Perplexity + TabStack fallback bridge for fresh local-race discovery and official-page extraction when primary ballot providers are unavailable or stale.
Added MongoDB bulk-import-first strategy for FEC and Congress.gov/GPO data, with live official API refreshes for missing, stale, or user-requested information.
Added public-first Clerk authentication strategy for optional saved user workspaces and protected admin operations.
Added Clerk environment placeholders, MongoDB user workspace collections, API route policy, tool contracts, and build-plan acceptance tests.

Added unitedstates/congress-legislators as a selective MongoDB enrichment import for member identity, official webpages, social media, district offices, committee assignments, FEC crosswalks, and photo resolver metadata.

decisions.hackathon_mvp_scope: Local and non-federal races are deferred. MVP focuses on congressional district intelligence, FEC finance, Congress.gov context, evidence-backed issue comparison, CopilotKit, MongoDB, Geocod.io, and HeroUI Pro.
decisions.state_local_election_layer: Post-MVP only; keep provider notes and schema ideas for later, but do not implement local/state ballot coverage for the hackathon.
